_doc: The one list of biome ids. Every other table (data/worldgen/biomes.json, data/sim/biomes.json, data/sim/cultures.json, data/ecology/habitats.json and spawning.json, data/dressing.json, the sites in world meta) may name only these; tests/test_biome_vocab.gd fails otherwise. family: surface or underground. generated: worldgen makes it today (surface ones have a row in data/worldgen/biomes.json, underground ones beyond caves and underdark a region kind in its 'underground' section); the others keep their sim and habitat data for when it does. Merged away in M5: plains and grassland (meadow), mountains and alpine (mountain), snow and arctic (tundra), cavern (caves).
